Object.name: pgp-message
Object.description: An OpenPGP message or signature artifact. Link a pgp-meta object containing observed recipient or issuer key IDs using extracted-from. Extracted IDs alone do not prove that a message was signed or encrypted by a particular key holder.

Attribute.value:
-----BEGIN PGP MESSAGE-----
... original armored message data ...
-----END PGP MESSAGE-----

Object.comment: Illustrative artifact only; replace the message value with the original OpenPGP message. No decryption or signature verification is asserted.

Object.name: pgp-meta
Object.description: Metadata extracted from a PGP keyblock, message or signature
Object.comment: Example recipient key ID; replace with an ID actually observed in the message packets.
